I always go for just a simple pan fried breast with some kind of sauce. Usually some sort of fruit sauce that would typically be used with game or sauce au poivre.

Pan frying tips: score the fat on the breast down to the meat without cutting into the meat. This will help the fat render without overcooking the duck. Then put it in a cold pan skin side down and put on medium to medium high heat. By the time it's ready to flip the skin should be perfect and then you just flip and finish to medium rare. Also you can spoon the duck fat over the skin to make sure it gets really nice and crispy.
